question: 近30天GMV走势（按天）
golden_sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', order_purchase_ts) AS dt, SUM(line_gmv) AS gmv FROM vw_fact_items WHERE order_purchase_ts >= (SELECT CAST(MAX(order_purchase_ts) AS DATE) FROM vw_fact_items) - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 上个月订单数、GMV、客单价分别是多少？
golden_sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', CAST(MAX(order_purchase_ts) AS DATE)) AS cur_month FROM vw_fact_items) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS paid_orders, SUM(line_gmv) AS gmv, SUM(line_gmv) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS aov FROM vw_fact_items, anchor WHERE order_purchase_ts >= cur_month - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND order_purchase_ts < cur_month

question: 按州(state)看GMV Top 10（近90天）
golden_sql: SELECT customer_state, SUM(line_gmv) AS gmv FROM vw_fact_items WHERE order_purchase_ts >= (SELECT CAST(MAX(order_purchase_ts) AS DATE) FROM vw_fact_items) - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 10

question: 准时送达率按月趋势（最近6个月）
golden_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_purchase_ts) AS month, AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_ts <= order_estimated_delivery_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_rate FROM vw_delivered_orders WHERE order_purchase_ts >= (SELECT CAST(MAX(order_purchase_ts) AS DATE) FROM vw_delivered_orders) - INTERVAL 6 MONTH GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 延迟送达订单平均评分 vs 准时订单平均评分（最近6个月）
golden_sql: WITH base AS (SELECT d.order_id, CASE WHEN d.order_delivered_customer_ts <= d.order_estimated_delivery_ts THEN 'on_time' ELSE 'delayed' END AS delivery_type, r.review_score FROM vw_delivered_orders d LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON d.order_id = r.order_id WHERE d.order_purchase_ts >= (SELECT CAST(MAX(order_purchase_ts) AS DATE) FROM vw_delivered_orders) - INTERVAL 6 MONTH AND r.review_score IS NOT NULL) SELECT delivery_type, AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM base GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 新客占比按月趋势（今年以来）
golden_sql: WITH first_order AS (SELECT customer_unique_id, MIN(order_purchase_ts) AS first_ts FROM vw_fact_items GROUP BY 1), base AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', f.order_purchase_ts) AS month, f.order_id, f.customer_unique_id, fo.first_ts FROM vw_fact_items f LEFT JOIN first_order fo ON f.customer_unique_id = fo.customer_unique_id WHERE f.order_purchase_ts >= date_trunc('year', (SELECT CAST(MAX(order_purchase_ts) AS DATE) FROM vw_fact_items))) SELECT month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS paid_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN date_trunc('month', first_ts) = month THEN order_id END) AS new_customer_orders, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN date_trunc('month', first_ts) = month THEN order_id END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS new_customer_ratio FROM base GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 近60天每天新客数和老客数
golden_sql: WITH first_order AS (SELECT customer_unique_id, CAST(MIN(order_purchase_ts) AS DATE) AS first_date FROM vw_fact_items GROUP BY 1), daily AS (SELECT CAST(f.order_purchase_ts AS DATE) AS dt, f.customer_unique_id, fo.first_date FROM vw_fact_items f LEFT JOIN first_order fo ON f.customer_unique_id = fo.customer_unique_id WHERE f.order_purchase_ts >= (SELECT CAST(MAX(order_purchase_ts) AS DATE) FROM vw_fact_items) - INTERVAL 60 DAY) SELECT dt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN first_date = dt THEN customer_unique_id END) AS new_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN first_date < dt THEN customer_unique_id END) AS returning_customers FROM daily GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 比较最近30天与前30天的GMV变化
golden_sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT CAST(MAX(order_purchase_ts) AS DATE) AS last_date FROM vw_fact_items) SELECT 'current_30d' AS period, SUM(line_gmv) AS gmv FROM vw_fact_items, anchor WHERE order_purchase_ts >= last_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY UNION ALL SELECT 'previous_30d' AS period, SUM(line_gmv) AS gmv FROM vw_fact_items, anchor WHERE order_purchase_ts >= last_date - INTERVAL 60 DAY AND order_purchase_ts < last_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY ORDER BY 1

question: 近90天各支付方式 payment_type 的GMV占比
golden_sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT CAST(MAX(order_purchase_ts) AS DATE) AS last_date FROM vw_eligible_orders), base AS (SELECT op.payment_type, op.payment_value FROM order_payments op JOIN vw_eligible_orders eo ON op.order_id = eo.order_id, anchor WHERE eo.order_purchase_ts >= last_date - INTERVAL 90 DAY) SELECT payment_type, SUM(payment_value) AS gmv, SUM(payment_value) / SUM(SUM(payment_value)) OVER () AS gmv_ratio FROM base GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv DESC

question: 近90天运费占比趋势（按周）

question: 近180天准时与延迟订单的评分分布
golden_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN d.order_delivered_customer_ts <= d.order_estimated_delivery_ts THEN 'on_time' ELSE 'delayed' END AS delivery_type, r.review_score, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM vw_delivered_orders d JOIN order_reviews r ON d.order_id = r.order_id WHERE d.order_purchase_ts >= (SELECT CAST(MAX(order_purchase_ts) AS DATE) FROM vw_delivered_orders) - INTERVAL 180 DAY GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

question: 最近6个月每月D30留存率
golden_sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT customer_unique_id, date_trunc('month', MIN(order_purchase_ts)) AS cohort_month, MIN(order_purchase_ts) AS first_ts FROM vw_fact_items GROUP BY 1), second_order AS (SELECT f.customer_unique_id, MIN(f.order_purchase_ts) AS second_ts FROM vw_fact_items f JOIN cohort c ON f.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id WHERE f.order_purchase_ts > c.first_ts GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.cohort_month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.second_ts <= c.first_ts + INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN c.customer_unique_id END) AS retained_d30, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.second_ts <= c.first_ts + INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN c.customer_unique_id END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS d30_retention FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN second_order s ON c.customer_unique_id = s.customer_unique_id WHERE c.cohort_month >= (SELECT CAST(MAX(order_purchase_ts) AS DATE) FROM vw_fact_items) - INTERVAL 6 MONTH GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 最近6个月每月D7留存率
golden_sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT customer_unique_id, date_trunc('month', MIN(order_purchase_ts)) AS cohort_month, MIN(order_purchase_ts) AS first_ts FROM vw_fact_items GROUP BY 1), second_order AS (SELECT f.customer_unique_id, MIN(f.order_purchase_ts) AS second_ts FROM vw_fact_items f JOIN cohort c ON f.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id WHERE f.order_purchase_ts > c.first_ts GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.cohort_month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.second_ts <= c.first_ts + INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN c.customer_unique_id END) AS retained_d7, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.second_ts <= c.first_ts + INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN c.customer_unique_id END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS d7_retention FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN second_order s ON c.customer_unique_id = s.customer_unique_id WHERE c.cohort_month >= (SELECT CAST(MAX(order_purchase_ts) AS DATE) FROM vw_fact_items) - INTERVAL 6 MONTH GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 分期订单占比按月趋势（最近6个月）
